notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Leafkin Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Leafkin Druid.
Repeat.
